adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the code changed from `refreshTokenResponseSchema.safeParse(responseJson)` (with `console.error(...)` and continuing) to `parseRefreshTokenResponse(responseJson, refreshTokenResponseSchema)`. In `parseRefreshTokenResponse`, a failed parse throws (`if (!refreshTokenResponse.success) { throw new Error(...) }`), so execution no longer “logs and continues” on invalid token responses. As a result, `tokenResponse.success && tokenResponse.data` is effectively redundant/dead because `tokenResponse.success` must be true if the function returned. The finding’s point about behavior change and dead code is verifiable from the diff; however, the claim about tests not being updated is not verifiable from this diff alone.
